title: awesome-dsh-plugins registry
description: Machine-readable registry of DeepSeek Harness (dsh) extensions. data/plugins.json is the source of truth; README.md is rendered from it. dsh is a developer preview with promised breaking changes, which is why every entry records the dsh version it was last verified against.

updated.description: Date the registry data was last edited (YYYY-MM-DD)

name.description: Display name, unique across the registry

path.description: Subdirectory inside the repo, for monorepo entries

description.description: One honest sentence; no keyword stuffing

category.description: bundle: npm package with a dsh.bundle manifest that ships a patch layer. plugin: a Cordis plugin activated via patch rows. skill: Anthropic-format SKILL.md unit. theme: UI skin. tool: developer tooling around dsh.

added.description: Date the entry entered the registry

lastVerified.description: Date a maintainer last checked the entry

verifiedAgainst.description: dsh version the entry was last checked against, e.g. 0.1.0-rc.5. Undated compatibility claims rot: the .dsh-plugin manifest format was deleted 2026-08-09 with no migration.

status.description: verified: install path confirmed against verifiedAgainst (manifest or skill-layout inspection at minimum). unverified: listed, not yet checked. broken: known not to work against verifiedAgainst.
